# Corpus inputs whose spoken form departs from the training data's on purpose, grouped by cause.
# Each line that is neither blank nor a # comment is one input, written as a Go quoted string for strconv.Unquote.

# A vertical tab is no \s to Go's regular expressions, so a rule needing a space there does not match.
"Temperature\v-5 today and \v-3 more"
"Rome fell in 843 B.\vC. and rose in 476 A.\vD."
"Temperature\v-5 today and \v-3 more \u2014 r\u00e9sum\u00e9."
"Rome fell in 843 B.\vC. and rose in 476 A.\vD. (na\u00efve)"
"Rome\nfell\nin 843 B.\vC. and rose in 476 A.\vD."

# Go folds the Kelvin sign and the long s into k and s where a rule ignores case.
"tic\u212aet 1049238 and TIC\u212aET 7741890"
"tic\u212aet 1049238 and TIC\u212aET 7741890 \u2014 r\u00e9sum\u00e9."
"tic\u212aet 1049238 and TIC\u212aET 7741890 Utah"
